lines.notes: 82.15 km semi-high-speed regional rapid transit corridor connecting Sarai Kale Khan in Delhi to Modipuram in Meerut via Ghaziabad across 14 operational stations. The official sanctioned project length of 82.15 km includes stabling yards and depot spurs (Duhai Depot branch and Modipuram Depot connection tracks); the 2D passenger mainline surveyed in OSM measures 78.23 km. Meerut Metro operates local services over 21.25 km across 12 revenue passenger stations on the shared infrastructure between Meerut South and Modipuram (the 13th station cited in press is the at-grade Modipuram Depot station per NCRTC official map https://ncrtc.in/interactive-map/).
